title: Kenny Chesney Celebrates New Album ‘Silver Sands Marina’ on No Shoes Radio
summary: Kenny shares the stories behind his new album track by track on No Shoes Radio.
body_markdown:
[Kenny Chesney](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/kenny-chesney) is releasing his new album, *Silver Sands Marina* , on September 25 — and SiriusXM’s[No Shoes Radio (Ch. 59)](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/no-shoes-radio) is celebrating with exclusive programming throughout September.


[No Shoes Radio Kenny Chesney’s channel Listen on the App Listen on the App](https://sxm.app.link/BlogKennyChesneySilverSandsMarina)


On album release day, tune in for a special *Silver Sands Marina* track-by-track hosted by Kenny, as he takes listeners inside the new music and shares the stories behind the songs.


In the meantime, watch the new music video for “Goldfish,” from *Silver Sands Marina* , above.


### Hear Kenny Chesney’s *Silver Sands Marina* Track-by-Track


On Friday, September 25, Kenny takes listeners behind *Silver Sands Marina* during an exclusive track-by-track album special on No Shoes Radio.


Hear Kenny share the stories behind the songs and offer listeners a deeper look at the making of his new album. The special is part of exclusive No Shoes Radio programming throughout September celebrating the release of *Silver Sands Marina* .


**Premiere:** Friday, September 25
**Channel:** No Shoes Radio on car radios and the[SiriusXM app](https://sxm.app.link/BlogKennyChesneySilverSandsMarina)


### About Kenny Chesney’s *Silver Sands Marina*


Arriving September 25,[Silver Sands Marina](https://kennychesney.lnk.to/silversandsmarina) is Kenny’s 21st studio album and marks a return to what he describes as the experience of creating an album as a complete collection rather than simply a group of individual tracks.


“With all the tracks, the playlists, the drops, I think we’ve forgotten the power of an actual collection of songs designed to work as a whole,” Kenny said.


The 11-song album opens with “Burn My Boat” and closes with “Shot Glass,” with songs exploring emotions, turning points, humor, memories, and the moments that shape a life. *Silver Sands Marina* also features appearances from Lily Meola, Megan Moroney, and Colbie Caillat.


Co-produced by Kenny and longtime collaborator Buddy Cannon, *Silver Sands Marina* draws on songs from writers including Shane McAnally, Matraca Berg, Tia Sillers, Jessie Alexander, Jessi Jo Dillon, Adam Wright, and Tennille Townes.


The album includes the title track “Silver Sands Marina,” “Burn My Boat,” and “Carry On,” Kenny’s first independent-label single and his 100th charting single.


For more information on Kenny’s new album, *Silver Sands Marina* , visit[KennyChesney.com](https://www.kennychesney.com/) .
